tasks.notes: Build-spec §8.3. A saved preset of SEVERAL invoice lines (a single catalogue item already serves as a one-line template — ADR 0041). Deferred from feat-products-catalog: a multi-line template entity has no consumer until invoicing (feat-sales-invoicing) can apply it; revisit when §8.4 needs grouped presets.

tasks.title: Opening balances (inngående balanse) for mid-year migration
tasks.notes: Build-spec §8.1 (Phase 1). Let a user migrating mid-year enter opening balances so the ledger and the honest-number reveal are correct from day one (today the only way in is manual vouchers from zero). Must post a balanced opening voucher through the existing posting path + integrity triggers; an opening balance is still an append-only voucher (no ledger bypass).

tasks.title: Sales & invoicing — quotes -> immutable gapless invoices -> credit notes (the product core)
tasks.notes: Build-spec §8.4. DONE (ADR 0042): `invoice` + `invoice_line` tables in one `kind` model (quote/invoice/credit_note); pure @saldo/domain invoice module (per-line net/VAT via checkSalesLine reusing checkVatLine, document totals, vat breakdown, lifecycle state machine draft->issued->sent->viewed->paid + overdue, invoiceKid mod10) with exhaustive + fast-check tests. Per-line MVA HARD BLOCK is server-authoritative (the action derives every line against the committed SAF-T list and refuses a blocked line; client preview is UX only). GAPLESS numbering via allocate_invoice_number in the issuing tx + per-invoice KID; an issued document is APPEND-ONLY via SQL triggers (financial/identity columns frozen, only status+timestamps advance; lines frozen). RLS tenancy + same-org composite FKs (customer/account/VAT/product/credit-link). Testcontainers integrity test: gaplessness under concurrency AND rollback, immutability of doc + lines, same-org FK rejection, RLS isolation. NO/EN microcopy; WCAG 2.2 AA; §5.5 sober voice on issue. Ledger posting (the AR voucher) is split to feat-invoice-ledger-posting; PDF/email + recurring/reminders remain feat-invoice-pdf-email / feat-recurring-invoices-reminders.

tasks.title: Post the AR voucher to the general ledger when a sales invoice is issued
tasks.notes: DONE (ADR 0043). Issuing a sales invoice / credit note now posts a balanced AR voucher (debit receivable gross / credit revenue per line / credit output VAT per rate) atomically in the issuing tx, via the pure deriveSalesInvoice (reuses deriveSales) + reverseVoucher for the credit-note motbilag. fiscal_period resolved from the issue date; voucher.invoice_id links the document to its ledger entry (partial UNIQUE prevents double-post). VAT is treatment-gated like computeLine so it ties out to the frozen vat_ore (a reverse-charge line posts revenue-at-net, no phantom VAT leg). Testcontainers integrity test proves balance, correct unlocked period, reverse-charge tie-out, credit-note reversal, and atomic rollback on a locked period. Follow-ons: vat-reverse-charge (dual-leg + tighten the sales-line gate), feat-invoice-pdf-email.

tasks.title: GDPR erasure / anonymisation path for data NOT under statutory hold
tasks.notes: Build-spec §11 + .claude/rules/data-handling.md. Project-wide gap the privacy reviewer keeps flagging (data-export is partly tracked under feat-audit-trail-export; erasure is not). Implement deletion/anonymisation ONLY for personal data not under statutory hold: contact register fields, unposted invoice drafts, marketing/notes fields — NEVER posted ledger rows or issued invoice/credit-note snapshots (5-year bokføringslov retention; the immutability triggers must keep blocking them). Document the lawful basis (legal obligation) + the retention exception, and explicitly name the held columns (e.g. invoice.customer_*). Companion to the data-export half of feat-audit-trail-export (GDPR Art. 20 vs Art. 17).

tasks.title: Invoice PDF generation + email delivery (EU provider) + EHF/PEPPOL validate
tasks.notes: DONE (ADR 0046). Issued invoice/credit note renders to PDF via @react-pdf/renderer on the Node host (.pdf resource route); the per-rate MVA-grunnlag is summed from FROZEN line amounts via the pure frozenVatBreakdown — money never recomputed. Email delivery through the provider-agnostic nodemailer SMTP interface (Postmark EU, ADR 0045): fail-closed EMAIL_REGION=eu gate + requireTLS, credentials from env.ts only, recipients/bodies never logged (pino redaction); the send is a §5.5 explicit-confirm act that advances draft/issued->sent and records to the append-only invoice_email log (RLS + same-org FK; Testcontainers RLS test). EHF/PEPPOL BIS 3.0 generated locally (pure UBL builder in @saldo/domain/peppol) + a grounded business-rule validator + pnpm ehf:validate gate, grounded in db/reference/peppol/bis-billing-3.0.md — the subset + well-formedness ('start now' §9), full VEFA Schematron + transmission + structured buyer address deferred to feat-peppol-send.

tasks.title: Recurring/subscription invoices + reminders (purring) via in-Postgres jobs
tasks.notes: Build-spec §8.4. Subscription/recurring invoices + reminders (purring) driven by graphile-worker (in-Postgres jobs, ADR 0010 — payloads never transit a non-EU SaaS, §11). First real consumer of the jobs layer (none exists yet under apps/web/app/jobs). Late interest (forsinkelsesrenter) + inkasso hand-off is the separate feat-torpedo.

tasks.title: Supplier invoices, expense rules, owner draws & mileage (purchases completion)
tasks.notes: Build-spec §8.5 + §16 Phase 4. Completes purchases beyond receipt extraction (feat-receipt-extraction, done): manual supplier-invoice entry with per-supplier defaults; the input-VAT fork by MVA status (deriveStandard*); encoded non-deductible rules (representasjon, vehicles, private use); reverse charge on foreign services (vat-reverse-charge); recurring expenses; owner outlays (utlegg) & drawings (privatuttak); mileage/travel deductions (kjøregodtgjørelse/diett) as deductions, not payroll. All posts through the existing append-only ledger path.

tasks.title: Banking import — GoCardless PSD2/AIS + camt.054 + CSV
tasks.notes: Build-spec §8.7 + §9 + §16 Phase 5. DONE (ADR 0047): pure domain normaliser (camt.054 + GoCardless + CSV → signed øre, exhaustive + property tests), self-built camt.054 parser (fast-xml-parser at the boundary), fail-closed GoCardless AIS client (EU-resident gate, Zod at boundary, no PII logs, 1-batch/no-poll rate-limit safety), bank_account + bank_transaction tables (force RLS + same-org FK + append-only trigger + idempotent UNIQUE(external_ref)), routes/UI for accounts + file/GoCardless import, Testcontainers integrity test. Sources captured under db/reference/banking/. AIS fetch runs inline-with-idempotency (jobs surface not built — see ADR 0047). Matching/reconciliation is the downstream task (feat-reconciliation): only a nullable kid/matched_voucher_id is stored.

tasks.title: Bank reconciliation — KID/amount/date auto-match + manual workflow
tasks.notes: Build-spec §8.7 + §10(2). DONE (ADR 0048): pure @saldo/domain matcher (KID-exact → amount+date → amount, exhaustive + fast-check) reusing the Kid mod-10 check, and a pure deriveSettlement (debit bank 1920 / credit receivable 1500, balanced øre); reconcileMatch posts the bank settlement voucher via the reused insertPostedVoucher, links bank_transaction.matched_voucher_id (+kid) — the only mutation the append-only trigger permits — and marks the invoice paid; a /bank/:id/reconcile route + UI (manual confirm per ADR 0002, NO/EN). Deterministic, NOT an AI system (Recital 12). Exact-amount settlement only; partial/over-payments + outgoing AP reconciliation deferred. Testcontainers integrity test (balanced legs, linked tx, invoice paid, atomic amount-mismatch reject, no double-post, undated-period fallback). vat-reviewer + privacy-reviewer run.

tasks.title: MVA-melding generation on SAF-T codes + Skatteetaten validation API
tasks.notes: Build-spec §8.8 + §16 Phase 6. Generate the MVA report per term (or annual) from the posted ledger on the SAF-T VAT codes, and validate against Skatteetaten's validation API (free but onboarding-gated; supports inquiries from the system supplier, §9). Submission via Altinn 3 is the separate feat-altinn-mva-submission (Phase 9). The rolling-12-month 50k threshold tracker is the existing vat-threshold-watcher. Validate the generated melding against the committed schema (saft-validate skill).

tasks.title: Reporting — resultat/balanse, hovedbok drill-down, reskontro aging, liquidity
tasks.notes: Build-spec §8.9 + §16 Phase 7. Resultatregnskap; balanse; hovedbok/kontospesifikasjon drill-down; reskontro with AR/AP aging; MVA-spesifikasjon; liquidity & outstanding-invoice dashboard; period-over-period comparison. Read-only aggregation over the posted ledger (extends the honest-number aggregation pattern, ADR 0033), RLS-scoped. Reskontro aging needs issued invoices/supplier invoices for full value.

tasks.title: Year-end close — carry-forward, næringsspesifikasjon figures, saldoavskrivning
tasks.notes: Build-spec §8.6 + §8.10 + §16 Phase 7. Year-end close with balance carry-forward + period locking of the closed year (existing period-lock triggers); næringsspesifikasjon figure generation; beregnet personinntekt basis (builds on feat-tax-estimate, ADR 0029); saldoavskrivning (declining-balance depreciation) schedules; year-end checklist; export/handoff to Skatteetaten's pre-filled return (full submission API deferred — §16 'Later'). Skattemelding deadline 31 May.

tasks.title: Full SAF-T Financial export (XSD-valid in CI) — replace the saft:validate scaffold
tasks.notes: Build-spec §8.11 + §16 Phase 8. Generate a full SAF-T Financial export from the ledger and XSD-validate it in CI on every export-logic change (§12). Replaces today's scaffold: pnpm saft:validate prints NOT YET IMPLEMENTED (CI label SCAFFOLD). The Norwegian SAF-T Financial schema + standard code lists are already committed under db/reference/saf-t/ (the standard-accounts list is copyright Regnskap Norge AS, licensed only for SAF-T mapping, §9). Use the saft-validate skill.

tasks.title: Immutable audit trail (sporbarhet) + full data export (anti-lock-in)
tasks.notes: Build-spec §8.11 + §11. Append-only audit_log capturing the actor (authenticated app_user) on every consequential write — the bokføringsforskrift sporbarhet requirement and the non-repudiation gap flagged in the security audit (audit-trail actor capture is currently 'intended'). Plus a full data export (SAF-T + raw) to prevent lock-in (GDPR Art. 20). audit_log is FORCE-RLS + append-only grant, like ai_provenance (ADR 0037).

tasks.title: Accountant access — limited-role membership
tasks.notes: Build-spec §8.12/§8.13. A limited-role accountant membership (the membership table + role already exist, ADR 0032/0020) so a regnskapsfører can be granted scoped access to an org. RLS-correct via withUserOrg; the role gates which actions/routes are permitted.

tasks.title: MVA-melding submission via Altinn 3 / ID-porten (onboarding-gated)
tasks.notes: Build-spec §8.8 + §9 + §16 Phase 9. Submit the validated MVA-melding via the Altinn 3 instance API, authenticated through ID-porten OIDC (Altinn token exchanged from ID-porten). Onboarding-gated; CAUTION (§9): the Altinn 2->3 transition and the systembruker/tilgangspakke model are in flux — confirm the current onboarding flow at build time. tasks.title: PEPPOL access point — EHF send/receive (commercial)

Local EHF/PEPPOL BIS 3.0 validation lands earlier with feat-invoice-pdf-email (VEFA, 'start now'). Open decision: PEPPOL access-point provider (roadmap Part 6).

tasks.title: Vipps MobilePay — ePayment / Recurring / Login (onboarding-gated)
tasks.notes: Build-spec §9 + §16 Phase 9. Get paid by Vipps (ePayment/Recurring) and optionally Vipps Login; merchant agreement + API keys, onboarding-gated. Lower priority than the filing/banking spine.

tasks.title: Content-Security-Policy with a per-request nonce for the RR7 hydration script
tasks.notes: The safe security headers (X-Frame-Options, X-Content-Type-Options, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy, prod HSTS) ship in app/entry.server.tsx. CSP was deferred: RR7's inline hydration script (window.__reactRouterContext) needs a per-request nonce threaded through entry.server + <Scripts nonce>; a blind script-src would break hydration. Add a nonce generator, set script-src 'self' 'nonce-…' + a restrictive default-src/style-src/img-src/font-src (self + data: for fonts), and verify hydration in a running app — start report-only before enforce.

tasks.title: Move OIDC transaction state (state/nonce/verifier) to server-side storage
tasks.notes: Best-practice hardening surfaced by the security review (acceptable as-is): the OIDC round-trip stores state/nonce/codeVerifier in a short-TTL HttpOnly cookie (auth/oidc.server.ts). Move to a server-side row (Postgres, ~10-min TTL) keyed by an opaque cookie token so the values never leave the server. Low priority; OIDC is not live-verified yet.

tasks.title: Architecture-truth generator + domain-purity gate
tasks.notes: Derive the structural map (packages, domain submodules, web modules, route count, SQL integrity surface) into an AUTOGEN block in docs/architecture.md (pnpm arch:refresh), gate the drift in repo-lint, and mechanically enforce the one hard boundary: @saldo/domain source must be relative-imports-only with no Date.now/Math.random/new Date.
